title: Beaches and islands in 14 days
summary: Da Nang, Hoi An, the Cham Islands, Quy Nhon, Nha Trang, and Phu Quoc. Some coastal minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 1 — My Khe
days.body: My Khe is half a day and free to swim.

days.title: Day 3 — An Bang
days.body: An Bang is half a day.

days.title: Day 4 — Cham Islands
days.body: Hai Tang is a short walk from the landing, 70,000 VND per person per visit.

days.title: Day 5 — Toward Quy Nhon
days.body: Travel toward Quy Nhon. The minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 6 — Ky Co
days.body: Ky Co is about an hour.

days.title: Day 7 — Eo Gio
days.body: Eo Gio is about 30 minutes, 25,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 8 — Toward Nha Trang
days.body: Travel toward Nha Trang. The minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 9 — Hon Mun
days.body: Hon Mun is a boat day. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 11 — Fly via Ho Chi Minh City
Day 13 — Sao
days.body: Sao is half a day and free.
